purpose: Teach: 炊い/吹き出し/バリア/しびれ/丸め/きれる/集まら/すりゃ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お米、本気で、絶対、葵で、絶対、炊いた、絶対、ご飯、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm serious—I absolutely love how you cook rice. Really, truly.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Leans forward slightly. Soft emphasis on 'absolutely.' No performance, just sincerity offered quietly across the table.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、漫画の、絶対、吹き出し、絶対、お洒落だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. You know, the way you talk about your café—it's like something out of a manga. So elegant.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Noticing tone—she's really seeing Aoi. Gentle, almost tender. Slow enough to let the observation land.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、皆との、絶対、バリア、絶対、なくて、絶対、いいわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your café doesn't have that wall between you and everyone else. That's what I love about it. Really admire that about you.
lines.style: Sincere and unhurried. Slight warmth in the voice—she's articulating something she means deeply. No rush. Genuine observation wrapped in affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、長時間立っていると、絶対、足、絶対、しびれる、絶対、ことが、絶対、あるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though I'll tell you, standing for hours straight—my feet go numb sometimes. That's the reality.
lines.style: Gentle deflection. A small laugh underneath. Not complaining, just being honest. Self-aware, a little wry. Grounding the conversation in something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お肉、絶対、丸めて、絶対、お団子、絶対、お洒落よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: But the way you shape those meatballs into little dango—that's so elegant. I really do admire that.
lines.style: Returning to warmth and admiration. Softer attack than before. Genuinely delighted by small, careful details. The voice carries real appreciation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、よくきれる、絶対、包丁、絶対、いい仕事道具、絶対、揃えているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've put together such good tools—your knives are sharp, your setup is solid. That's real craftsmanship.
lines.style: Practical acknowledgment with underlying warmth. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive. Noticing and valuing the work that goes invisible.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお客様、本気で、絶対、集まらない、絶対、日も、絶対、あるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though there are days when customers don't come in, aren't there? Even you have those.
lines.style: Gentle reality-check. Not cheerful, but not heavy either. Just acknowledging what's true. Meeting Aoi where she actually is, not where she performs.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、頑張りすぎ、絶対、なくても、絶対、休憩、絶対、すりゃ、絶対、いいわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You don't have to push so hard all the time. Sometimes it's enough to just take a break. That's okay too.
lines.style: Tender and clear. A soft permission underneath. Leaning in slightly—this is said with care. Warm but not coddling. Real guidance offered as a gift.
